newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Tractebel to invest $230 mln in Peru.
newsitem.headline: Tractebel to invest $230 mln in Peru.

text.p: Belgian public utility and industrial services group Tractebel said on Wednesday it would invest $230 million to buy a power plant from copper miner Southern Peru Ltd, and construct a new plant.
Southern Peru said on Tuesday it would sell the existing power plant to Tractebel unit Powerfin SA for $44 million. Tractebel and Powerfin are about to merge.
Tractebel said it would finance its investment 35 percent through capital and 65 percent with loans.

"This new project represents another important advance for Tractebel in Latin America," said Daniel Deroux, Tractebel's management committee member responsible for international gas and electricity operations.
Tractebel already has operations in Argentina and Chile.
Southern said in a statement on Tuesday that Powerfin would supply Peru's largest copper miner with electricity for 20 years.
It said in a statement that Powerfin agreed to make sufficient investments to increase energy supply from the plant to satisfy the miner's expansion plans.

Majority owned by ASARCO Inc and Peru's largest copper producer, Southern accounts for about 60 percent of Peru's total copper output from its Cuajone and Toquepala open-pit mines, according to the Energy and Mines Ministry.
